description: I'm the architect on a side-by-side duplex with a wall that is angled about 20 degrees to the side property line, so it runs from 1.2 m to 3.0 m away. For the window-area calculation we'd like to use the average distance of the wall, about 2.1 m, rather than drawing the plane at the closest point. Using the closest point cuts our glazing allowance by more than half.
known_facts: skewed wall 1.2 m to 3.0 m from the side property line
average distance 2.1 m proposed for unprotected-opening area

missing_info.why: Section A of the variance form

gold.departure: Exposing building face location for a skewed wall taken at the average distance instead of the plane with no unprotected openings in front of it.

should_cite.why: maximum aggregate area of unprotected openings
glazed openings in houses, if the duplex is treated under the house provisions

gold.engineering_reason: Two-unit residential building is within the exemption; the architect is engaged by choice.
